name: Stock buffer and GM shop
description: Spawns the stock Scheme Buffer (NPC 50008) and the stock GM Shop (NPC 50010). Buffs this NPC applies last DurationSec; other casters keep the skill duration.

DurationSec.description: Seconds a buff from the stock Scheme Buffer NPC lasts. 0 = leave the duration applyEffects just set. Does not change player, bot or item casts.
